source.text: ה֗וֹי עֲטֶ֤רֶת גֵּאוּת֙ שִׁכֹּרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצִ֥יץ נֹבֵ֖ל צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ גֵּֽיא־שְׁמָנִ֖ים הֲל֥וּמֵי יָֽיִן׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe, [the] crown of pride of [the] drunkards of Ephraim, and [the] flower fading, [the] beauty of its splendor, which [is] on [the] head of [the] valley of fatness of [those] struck down [by] wine!

en.L: Woe, the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, \q and the fading flower of its glorious beauty, \q which [is] on [the] head of [the] valley of richness of [those] struck down [by] wine!
en.B: Woe to the proud garland of Ephraim's drunkards, \q to the wilting blossom of its splendid beauty, \q set at the head of the fertile valley of those laid low by wine!
en.R: How terrible it will be for Samaria, the proud crown of the drunken people of Israel's northern kingdom! \q It sits at the top of a rich valley. But its beauty is like a flower that is drying up. Its people have been knocked down by wine.

es.L: ¡Ay, corona de soberbia de los borrachos de Efraín, \q y flor que se marchita de la hermosura de su gloria, \q que [está] sobre [la] cabeza del valle fértil de [los] vencidos [por el] vino!
es.B: ¡Ay de la orgullosa guirnalda de los borrachos de Efraín, \q de la flor marchita de su espléndida hermosura, \q puesta en lo alto del valle fértil de los que el vino derriba!
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para Samaria, la orgullosa corona de la gente borracha del reino del norte de Israel! \q Está en lo alto de un valle fértil. Pero su belleza es como una flor que se está secando. Su gente ha sido derribada por el vino.

fr.L: Malheur, couronne d’orgueil des ivrognes d’Éphraïm, \q et fleur fanée de sa splendide beauté, \q qui [est] sur la tête de la vallée grasse de [ceux que] le vin abat !
fr.B: Malheur à la couronne orgueilleuse des ivrognes d’Éphraïm, \q à la fleur fanée de sa splendide beauté, \q posée au sommet de la vallée fertile de ceux que le vin terrasse !
fr.R: Quel malheur pour Samarie, la couronne orgueilleuse des ivrognes du royaume du nord, Israël ! \q Elle se dresse au sommet d’une riche vallée. Mais sa beauté est comme une fleur qui se dessèche. Ses habitants sont assommés par le vin.

sw.L: Ole, taji la kiburi la walevi wa Efraimu, \q na ua linalonyauka la uzuri wa fahari yake, \q lililo juu ya kichwa cha bonde la unono la [wale] walioangushwa [na] divai!
sw.B: Ole wao walevi wa Efraimu na shada lao la kiburi, \q na ua linalonyauka la uzuri wake wa fahari, \q lililowekwa juu ya bonde lenye rutuba la wale walioangushwa na divai!
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa Samaria, taji la kiburi la watu walevi wa ufalme wa kaskazini wa Israeli! \q Umekaa juu ya bonde lenye rutuba. Lakini uzuri wake ni kama ua linalonyauka. Watu wake wameangushwa na divai.

vi.L: Khốn cho mão miện kiêu ngạo của những kẻ say rượu của Ép-ra-im, \q và cho bông hoa tàn héo của vẻ đẹp huy hoàng của nó, \q là [mão miện] ở trên đầu thung lũng màu mỡ của những kẻ bị rượu quật ngã!
vi.B: Khốn cho vòng hoa kiêu hãnh của bọn say sưa Ép-ra-im, \q cho đóa hoa đang tàn của vẻ đẹp lộng lẫy nó, \q đặt trên đầu thung lũng phì nhiêu của những kẻ bị rượu đánh gục!
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho Sa-ma-ri, mão miện kiêu hãnh của những người say rượu thuộc vương quốc phía bắc của Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Thành ấy nằm trên đỉnh một thung lũng màu mỡ. Nhưng vẻ đẹp của nó như một bông hoa đang héo tàn. Dân của nó đã bị rượu quật ngã.

decisions.choice: the crown on the head of the valley: Samaria, capital of Ephraim, the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Samaria stood on a rounded hill above a fertile valley, ringed by its walls like a crown or a garland on a head. Ephraim, the largest northern tribe, stands for the whole northern kingdom (7:2; 9:8). Assyria took Samaria in 722 BC, so this oracle dates from before that fall.

decisions.choice: crown, fading flower: a wreath of flowers worn at a drinking feast, already wilting
decisions.reason: Revelers wore garlands of flowers at banquets. The proud city is pictured as the wreath on a drunkard's head, beautiful for a moment and already withering (40:7-8).

decisions.choice: struck down by wine: overcome by drink
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a blow that knocks someone down (16:8, of vines). Wine has beaten them as an enemy would.

decisions.choice: Samaria; Israel's northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Readable names the city the crown stands for and explains Ephraim (see m1).

decisions.choice: ¡Ay ...! (L, B); ¡Qué terrible será para ...! (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms of hoy, as the terms note and Matthew 23:13; Literal follows the English L "Woe, the crown" with a bare "¡Ay, corona ...!".

decisions.choice: "Ole, ..." (L); "Ole wao ..." (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ..." (R)
decisions.reason: The cry hoy is worded this way at each level throughout this block, as the terms note settles from Luke 6:24; Balanced names those on whom the woe falls with "wao".

decisions.choice: "Malheur, ..." (L), "Malheur à ..." (B), "Quel malheur pour ... !" (R) for hoy, for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note and Matthew 23:13 at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L, B); "Thật khốn khổ cho" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for hoy as a threat, as Matthew 11:21 and 23:13; used unchanged through these chapters.

source.text: הִנֵּ֨ה חָזָ֤ק וְאַמִּץ֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔י כְּזֶ֥רֶם בָּרָ֖ד שַׂ֣עַר קָ֑טֶב כְּ֠זֶרֶם מַ֣יִם כַּבִּירִ֥ים שֹׁטְפִ֛ים הִנִּ֥יחַ לָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [one] mighty and strong [belongs] to [the] Lord, like a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, like a storm of waters mighty, overflowing, he has thrust [it] down to [the] ground with [the] hand.

en.L: Look, [one] mighty and strong [belongs] to the Lord, \q like a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, \q like a storm of mighty waters overflowing; he will throw [it] down to the ground with [the] hand.
en.B: Look, the Lord holds ready one who is mighty and powerful. \q Like a storm of hail and a wrecking wind, \q like a downpour of great waters that sweep all before them, he will dash it to the ground by force.
en.R: Look! The Lord has someone strong and powerful ready to attack. \q He will come like a hailstorm and a destroying wind, \q like a heavy rain that floods everything. He will throw Samaria's crown to the ground with great force.

es.L: He aquí, [uno] fuerte y poderoso [tiene] el Señor, \q como tormenta de granizo, tempestad destructora, \q como tormenta de aguas caudalosas que se desbordan; [la] echará por tierra con [la] mano.
es.B: Mira, el Señor tiene preparado a uno fuerte y poderoso. \q Como una granizada y un viento devastador, \q como un aguacero de grandes aguas que lo arrastran todo, la arrojará al suelo con fuerza.
es.R: ¡Mira! El Señor tiene a alguien fuerte y poderoso listo para atacar. \q Vendrá como una granizada y un viento destructor, \q como una lluvia fuerte que lo inunda todo. Arrojará al suelo con gran fuerza la corona de Samaria.

fr.L: Voici, [quelqu’un de] fort et puissant [est] au Seigneur, \q comme un orage de grêle, une tempête dévastatrice, \q comme un orage d’eaux puissantes qui débordent ; il [la] jettera à terre avec la main.
fr.B: Voici : le Seigneur tient prêt quelqu’un de fort et de puissant. \q Comme un orage de grêle, un vent qui ravage, \q comme une trombe d’eaux puissantes qui emportent tout, il la jettera à terre avec force.
fr.R: Regardez ! Le Seigneur a quelqu’un de fort et de puissant, prêt à attaquer. \q Il viendra comme un orage de grêle et un vent destructeur, \q comme une grosse pluie qui inonde tout. Il jettera par terre avec violence la couronne de Samarie.

sw.L: Tazama, [yuko mmoja] hodari na mwenye nguvu [aliye] wa Bwana, \q kama dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe, tufani ya maangamizi, \q kama dhoruba ya maji mengi yanayofurika; atalitupa chini ardhini kwa mkono.
sw.B: Tazama, Bwana anaye tayari mmoja aliye hodari na mwenye nguvu. \q Kama dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe na upepo unaoharibu, \q kama mvua kubwa ya maji mengi yanayofagia kila kitu mbele yake, atalitupa chini kwa nguvu.
sw.R: Tazama! Bwana ana mtu mwenye nguvu na uwezo aliye tayari kushambulia. \q Atakuja kama dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe na upepo unaoharibu, \q kama mvua kubwa inayofurika kila kitu. Atalitupa chini taji la Samaria kwa nguvu nyingi.

vi.L: Kìa, Chúa có một [kẻ] mạnh mẽ và dũng mãnh, \q như cơn bão mưa đá, như trận cuồng phong hủy diệt, \q như cơn bão của nước lớn tràn ngập; nó sẽ dùng tay quăng [mão ấy] xuống đất.
vi.B: Kìa, Chúa có sẵn một kẻ dũng mãnh và hùng mạnh. \q Như cơn bão mưa đá và trận gió tàn phá, \q như trận mưa lớn cuốn trôi mọi thứ, kẻ ấy sẽ mạnh tay quật nó xuống đất.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Chúa có sẵn một kẻ mạnh mẽ và đầy quyền lực để tấn công. \q Kẻ ấy sẽ đến như cơn mưa đá và cơn gió hủy diệt, \q như trận mưa lớn làm ngập lụt mọi thứ. Kẻ ấy sẽ dùng hết sức ném mão miện của Sa-ma-ri xuống đất.

decisions.choice: one mighty and strong belonging to the Lord: the Assyrian king and his army, God's instrument
decisions.reason: The figure is not named. Isaiah elsewhere pictures Assyria as a flood sent by the Lord (8:7-8) and as the rod in God's hand (10:5). The storm and flood here fit that picture.

decisions.choice: with the hand: with force
decisions.reason: The bare phrase "with hand" means by sheer strength. What is thrown down is the crown of verse 1.

decisions.choice: ready to attack; Samaria's crown
decisions.reason: Readable says why the strong one is ready and names what he throws down (verses 1 and 3).

source.text: בְּרַגְלַ֖יִם תֵּֽרָמַ֑סְנָה עֲטֶ֥רֶת גֵּא֖וּת שִׁכּוֹרֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: With feet they will be trampled, [the] crown of pride of [the] drunkards of Ephraim.

en.L: With feet it will be trampled, \q the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim.
en.B: The proud garland of Ephraim's drunkards \q will be trodden underfoot.
en.R: Enemies will walk all over Samaria, \q the proud crown of Israel's drunken people.

es.L: Con los pies será pisoteada \q la corona de soberbia de los borrachos de Efraín.
es.B: La orgullosa guirnalda de los borrachos de Efraín \q será pisoteada.
es.R: Los enemigos pisotearán a Samaria, \q la orgullosa corona de la gente borracha de Israel.

fr.L: Avec les pieds elle sera piétinée, \q la couronne d’orgueil des ivrognes d’Éphraïm.
fr.B: La couronne orgueilleuse des ivrognes d’Éphraïm \q sera foulée aux pieds.
fr.R: Les ennemis piétineront Samarie, \q la couronne orgueilleuse des ivrognes d’Israël.

sw.L: Kwa miguu litakanyagwa, \q taji la kiburi la walevi wa Efraimu.
sw.B: Shada la kiburi la walevi wa Efraimu \q litakanyagwa chini ya miguu.
sw.R: Maadui watatembea juu ya Samaria, \q taji la kiburi la watu walevi wa Israeli.

vi.L: Bằng chân, nó sẽ bị giày đạp, \q mão miện kiêu ngạo của những kẻ say rượu của Ép-ra-im.
vi.B: Vòng hoa kiêu hãnh của bọn say sưa Ép-ra-im \q sẽ bị giày đạp dưới chân.
vi.R: Quân thù sẽ giày đạp Sa-ma-ri, \q là mão miện kiêu hãnh của những người say rượu của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: trampled underfoot: utter humiliation of a conquered city
decisions.reason: A crown thrown to the ground and stamped on pictures a city captured and shamed (25:10; 26:6).

decisions.choice: Enemies; Samaria
decisions.reason: Readable names who tramples and what the crown stands for (verse 1).

source.text: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה צִיצַ֤ת נֹבֵל֙ צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹ֖אשׁ גֵּ֣יא שְׁמָנִ֑ים כְּבִכּוּרָהּ֙בְּטֶ֣רֶם קַ֔יִץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְאֶ֤ה הָֽרֹאֶה֙ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּעוֹדָ֥הּ בְּכַפּ֖וֹ יִבְלָעֶֽנָּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [the] flower fading, [the] beauty of its splendor, which [is] on [the] head of [the] valley of fatness, like an early fig before summer, which [he] sees [it], the one seeing, while still it [is] in his palm, he swallows it.

en.L: And the fading flower of its glorious beauty, which [is] on [the] head of [the] valley of richness, \q will be like a first-ripe fig before summer, \q which the one who sees [it] sees; \q while it [is] still in his palm, he swallows it.
en.B: And the wilting blossom of its splendid beauty, set at the head of the fertile valley, \q will be like the first fig that ripens before summer: \q someone catches sight of it, \q and before it has left his hand, he has eaten it.
en.R: Samaria's beauty at the top of the rich valley is fading like a dying flower. \q It will be like the first fig of the season. \q Anyone who sees it grabs it and eats it right away. In the same way, the enemy will quickly swallow up the city.

es.L: Y la flor que se marchita de la hermosura de su gloria, que [está] sobre [la] cabeza del valle fértil, \q será como la breva antes del verano, \q que la ve el que [la] mira; \q apenas [está] en su mano, se la traga.
es.B: Y la flor marchita de su espléndida hermosura, puesta en lo alto del valle fértil, \q será como la primera breva que madura antes del verano: \q alguien la ve, \q y antes de que salga de su mano, ya se la ha comido.
es.R: La belleza de Samaria, en lo alto del valle fértil, se marchita como una flor que se muere. \q Será como el primer higo de la temporada. \q Cualquiera que lo ve, lo agarra y se lo come enseguida. Así también el enemigo se tragará rápidamente la ciudad.

fr.L: Et la fleur fanée de sa splendide beauté, qui [est] sur la tête de la vallée grasse, \q sera comme une figue précoce avant l’été, \q que voit celui qui [la] voit ; \q à peine est-elle dans sa main, il l’avale.
fr.B: Et la fleur fanée de sa splendide beauté, posée au sommet de la vallée fertile, \q sera comme la première figue mûre avant l’été : \q quelqu’un l’aperçoit, \q et elle n’a pas quitté sa main qu’il l’a déjà mangée.
fr.R: La beauté de Samarie, au sommet de la riche vallée, se fane comme une fleur qui meurt. \q Elle sera comme la première figue de la saison. \q Celui qui la voit l’attrape et la mange tout de suite. De la même façon, l’ennemi engloutira vite la ville.

sw.L: Na ua linalonyauka la uzuri wa fahari yake, lililo juu ya kichwa cha bonde la unono, \q litakuwa kama tini ya kwanza kuiva kabla ya kiangazi, \q ambayo yeye anayeiona huiona; \q ingali bado mkononi mwake, anaimeza.
sw.B: Na ua linalonyauka la uzuri wake wa fahari, lililowekwa juu ya bonde lenye rutuba, \q litakuwa kama tini ya kwanza inayoiva kabla ya kiangazi: \q mtu anaiona, \q na kabla haijatoka mkononi mwake, ameshaila.
sw.R: Uzuri wa Samaria juu ya bonde lenye rutuba unanyauka kama ua linalokufa. \q Utakuwa kama tini ya kwanza ya msimu. \q Yeyote anayeiona anaichukua na kuila mara moja. Vivyo hivyo, adui atauumeza mji upesi.

vi.L: Và bông hoa tàn héo của vẻ đẹp huy hoàng của nó, ở trên đầu thung lũng màu mỡ, \q sẽ như trái vả chín sớm trước mùa hè, \q mà người thấy [nó] thì thấy; \q khi nó còn trong lòng bàn tay, người ấy nuốt nó.
vi.B: Và đóa hoa đang tàn của vẻ đẹp lộng lẫy nó, đặt trên đầu thung lũng phì nhiêu, \q sẽ như trái vả đầu mùa chín trước mùa hè: \q có người trông thấy nó, \q và chưa kịp rời tay, người ấy đã ăn mất.
vi.R: Vẻ đẹp của Sa-ma-ri trên đỉnh thung lũng màu mỡ đang tàn phai như bông hoa sắp héo. \q Nó sẽ giống như trái vả đầu mùa. \q Ai thấy cũng hái ngay và ăn liền. Cũng vậy, quân thù sẽ nhanh chóng nuốt chửng thành ấy.

decisions.choice: an early fig before summer: the first fig of the year, eaten the moment it is found
decisions.reason: A few figs ripen in early summer, before the main harvest, and were prized (Hosea 9:10; Micah 7:1). No one saves such a fig; it is picked and eaten at once. So Samaria will be taken quickly and completely.

decisions.choice: the one who sees it ... swallows it: whoever finds it eats it at once
decisions.reason: The same root "swallow" returns in verse 7, where the leaders of Judah are "swallowed up" by wine.

decisions.choice: In the same way, the enemy will quickly swallow up the city.
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the picture; the enemy is the strong one of verse 2.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַעֲטֶ֣רֶת צְבִ֔י וְלִצְפִירַ֖ת תִּפְאָרָ֑ה לִשְׁאָ֖ר עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In the day the that will be Yahweh of hosts for a crown of beauty and for a diadem of splendor for [the] remnant of his people,

en.L: In that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts will be for a crown of beauty \q and for a diadem of splendor \q to the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people,
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will be the splendid crown, \q the beautiful garland, \q worn by the survivors of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people,
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will be like a beautiful crown \q for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are left.

es.L: En aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos será por corona de hermosura \q y por diadema de gloria \q para el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo,
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos será {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo la corona espléndida, \q la hermosa guirnalda \q que llevará el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo,
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos será {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo como una hermosa corona \q para los de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que queden.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées sera une couronne de beauté \q et un diadème de splendeur \q pour le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple,
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées sera {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} la couronne splendide, \q le diadème de beauté, \q que portera le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple,
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées sera {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} comme une belle couronne \q pour ceux qui resteront de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

sw.L: Katika siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atakuwa taji la uzuri \q na kilemba cha fahari \q kwa mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}},
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atakuwa taji la fahari, \q shada zuri, \q linalovaliwa na mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}},
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atakuwa kama taji zuri \q kwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waliobaki.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ là mão miện tuyệt đẹp \q và vương miện huy hoàng \q cho những người sót lại của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ là mão miện huy hoàng, \q là vòng hoa xinh đẹp \q cho những người sót lại của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},

decisions.choice: the LORD as crown: God himself replaces the fading crown of pride
decisions.reason: The words "crown", "beauty" and "splendor" from verses 1 and 4 return. Samaria's proud wreath withers, but the LORD becomes the glory of those who are left (4:2; 62:3).

decisions.choice: the remnant: those of God's people who survive the judgment
decisions.reason: A key idea in Isaiah (10:20-22; 11:11, 16), named in the name of his son Shear-jashub, "a remnant will return" (7:3).

decisions.choice: himself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "himself" to bring out the contrast with Samaria's crown.

decisions.choice: el remanente (L, B); los que queden (R)
decisions.reason: Sheʾar is "el remanente" at L and B and "los que queden" at R, as the terms note and Romans 9:27.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B); "watu waliobaki" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant is "mabaki" as Romans 9:27 and 2 Kings 19:31, at Balanced too although the English Balanced says "survivors"; Readable says "those who are left", as the terms note settles for this block.

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L, B), "ceux qui resteront" (R) for sheʾar, for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note and Romans 9:27; 2 Kings 19:31.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B); "những người còn sống sót" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for she'ar, as 2 Kings 19:4, 31; used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "chính" with no span
decisions.reason: The English adds "himself" with a span; Vietnamese says "chính" before the name, which is not a pronoun, so there is no span.

en.B: the spirit of justice \q in the one who presides over the court, \q and the strength of those who hurl the attack back at the gate.
en.R: He will help judges to be fair. \q He will give strength to soldiers who drive enemies back at the city gate.

decisions.choice: a spirit of justice: the power to judge rightly, given by God
decisions.reason: As with the king of 11:2-4, God's spirit enables right judgment. Here the LORD himself is that spirit for the judge.

decisions.choice: those who turn back the battle at the gate: defenders who drive the attackers away from the city gate
alternatives: those who drive the battle back to the enemy's gate
decisions.reason: The last word means "to the gate" or "at the gate". It may picture defenders pushing the enemy back from their own gate, or pursuing them back to the enemy's gate.

decisions.choice: judges; soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable names the people meant: the one who sits in judgment and the fighters at the gate.

decisions.choice: "thần công lý" (L); "thần công minh" (B), lowercase
decisions.reason: The spirit here is the power to judge rightly that the LORD gives; it is lowercase, since the line does not name the Spirit of God as a person.

records.literal_gloss: And also these with wine they reel and with strong drink they stagger; priest and prophet they reel with strong drink, they are swallowed from the wine, they stagger from the strong drink, they reel in the vision, they totter [in] decision.

en.L: And these also reel with wine \q and stagger with strong drink; \q priest and prophet reel with strong drink; they are swallowed up by wine; they stagger from strong drink; \q they reel in vision; they totter [in] judgment.
en.B: Yet these too sway with wine \q and lurch with beer. \q Priest and prophet sway with beer and are swallowed up by wine. They lurch from beer, \q sway as they see visions, and totter when they hand down a ruling.
en.R: But the leaders of Judah also stumble around because of wine and beer. \q Priests and prophets are drunk on beer. Wine has swallowed them up. They stagger because of beer. \q They stumble while they are seeing visions. They stumble when they decide cases.

es.L: Y también estos se tambalean por el vino \q y titubean por la bebida fuerte; \q sacerdote y profeta se tambalean por la bebida fuerte; son tragados por el vino; titubean por la bebida fuerte; \q se tambalean en la visión; vacilan [en el] juicio.
es.B: Pero también estos se tambalean por el vino \q y dan traspiés por la cerveza. \q El sacerdote y el profeta se tambalean por la cerveza y son tragados por el vino. Dan traspiés por la cerveza, \q se tambalean al ver visiones y vacilan al dictar sentencia.
es.R: Pero los jefes de Judá también andan tambaleándose por el vino y la cerveza. \q Los sacerdotes y los profetas están borrachos de cerveza. El vino se los ha tragado. Se tambalean por la cerveza. \q Tropiezan mientras ven visiones. Tropiezan cuando deciden los casos.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci aussi titubent sous le vin \q et chancellent sous la boisson forte ; \q prêtre et prophète titubent sous la boisson forte ; ils sont engloutis par le vin ; ils chancellent sous la boisson forte ; \q ils titubent dans la vision ; ils vacillent [dans] le jugement.
fr.B: Mais ceux-ci aussi titubent sous l’effet du vin \q et chancellent à cause de la bière. \q Prêtre et prophète titubent à cause de la bière et sont engloutis par le vin. Ils chancellent à cause de la bière, \q titubent en voyant leurs visions et vacillent en rendant leurs sentences.
fr.R: Mais les chefs de Juda, eux aussi, titubent à cause du vin et de la bière. \q Les prêtres et les prophètes sont ivres de bière. Le vin les a engloutis. Ils chancellent à cause de la bière. \q Ils titubent pendant qu’ils ont des visions. Ils titubent quand ils jugent les procès.

sw.L: Na hawa pia wanayumba kwa divai \q na kupepesuka kwa kileo; \q kuhani na nabii wanayumba kwa kileo; wamemezwa na divai; wanapepesuka kwa kileo; \q wanayumba katika maono; wanajikwaa [katika] hukumu.
sw.B: Lakini hawa nao wanayumba kwa divai \q na kupepesuka kwa pombe. \q Kuhani na nabii wanayumba kwa pombe na wamemezwa na divai. Wanapepesuka kwa pombe, \q wanayumba wanapoona maono, na kujikwaa wanapotoa uamuzi.
sw.R: Lakini viongozi wa Yuda nao wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya divai na pombe. \q Makuhani na manabii wamelewa pombe. Divai imewameza. Wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya pombe. \q Wanajikwaa wanapoona maono. Wanajikwaa wanapoamua kesi.

vi.L: Và những kẻ này cũng lảo đảo vì rượu \q và loạng choạng vì rượu mạnh; \q thầy tế lễ và tiên tri lảo đảo vì rượu mạnh; họ bị rượu nuốt mất; họ loạng choạng vì rượu mạnh; \q họ lảo đảo trong khải tượng; họ chao đảo [trong] xét đoán.

vi.R: Nhưng các nhà lãnh đạo của Giu-đa cũng lảo đảo vì rượu nho và rượu mạnh. \q Thầy tế lễ và nhà tiên tri say rượu mạnh. Rượu đã nuốt chửng họ. Họ loạng choạng vì rượu mạnh. \q Họ lảo đảo khi đang thấy khải tượng. Họ chao đảo khi xét xử.

decisions.choice: these also: the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, as drunk as Ephraim's
alternatives: the drunkards of Ephraim, described further
decisions.reason: After the northern kingdom (verses 1-4), the prophet turns to the leaders near him. Verse 14 names them: the rulers in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: strong drink: beer, the fermented drink made from grain
decisions.reason: The word is paired with wine throughout the Old Testament (5:11, 22; 24:9) and covers fermented drink other than wine, chiefly barley beer. The same word is used in the settled wording of 5:11.

decisions.choice: swallowed up by wine; reel in vision, totter in judgment
decisions.reason: "Swallowed up" can also mean "confused"; the word echoes the fig swallowed in verse 4. The prophet should see visions and the priest give rulings (Deuteronomy 17:9; Ezekiel 44:24); both duties are done while drunk.

decisions.choice: beer
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "beer" for the grain drink, as at 5:11 and 24:9; Literal keeps "strong drink".

decisions.choice: the leaders of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable names who "these" are (m1).

decisions.choice: "la boisson forte" (L), "la bière" (B, R) for shekhar, for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the English; a drink fermented from grain, not a distilled spirit.

decisions.choice: "rượu mạnh" at every level
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "rượu mạnh" is the published word for this drink (24:9 and the Pentateuch); "bia" would sound modern, so Balanced and Readable do not follow the English "beer".

decisions.choice: "hắn" for the prophet, in the leaders' mouths
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads verses 9-10 as the leaders mocking Isaiah; "hắn" carries their contempt.
