decisions.choice: tsav latsav, qav laqav: repeated sounds that mock the prophet's teaching as baby talk
alternatives: command on command, command on command, line on line, line on line
letters of the alphabet recited in a lesson
decisions.reason: The words are short, rhyming syllables, repeated like a nursery chant. They may be nonsense sounds, the babble of a small child. They may be the names of two letters of the alphabet drilled in a child's lessons. Or they may be real words: tsav is close to "command" and qav means "measuring line", so "command on command, line on line". The sound is the point, and it is kept at every level. The same syllables return in verse 13, where God turns the mockery back on the speakers, and qav returns in verse 17 as God's measuring line.

decisions.choice: a little there, a little there: bit by bit, as children are taught
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures a lesson given in small pieces, scorned as fit only for infants.

decisions.choice: tsav latsav, qav laqav (sounds kept)
alternatives: precept upon precept, line upon line
decisions.reason: The syllables are written out in letters so the reader hears the chant. A translation into words ("command on command") would lose the mockery; it is given in the footnote (m1).

decisions.choice: All he says is ...; It sounds like baby talk!
decisions.reason: Readable continues the leaders' quotation from verse 9 and states the point of the chant (m1).

decisions.choice: tsav latsav, qav laqav
alternatives: mandato sobre mandato, línea sobre línea
decisions.reason: The syllables are kept in Latin letters, as the English does, so the reader hears the chant; a translation into words would lose the mockery.

decisions.choice: "tsav latsav, qav laqav" kept as sounds
alternatives: "agizo juu ya agizo, kanuni juu ya kanuni"
decisions.reason: As in the English, the mocking syllables are kept as sounds, since their point is that they sound like baby talk; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: the syllables "tsav latsav, qav laqav" kept in Latin letters
decisions.reason: As in the English, the sounds are written out so the reader hears the chant the meaning decision describes; a translation into words would lose the mockery.

source.text: כִּ֚י בְּלַעֲגֵ֣י שָׂפָ֔ה וּבְלָשׁ֖וֹן אַחֶ֑רֶת יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For with stammerings of lip and with a tongue other he will speak to the people the this,

en.L: For with stammerings of lip and with another tongue \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will speak to this people,
en.B: Indeed, with halting speech and in a foreign language \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will speak to this people,
en.R: So now God will speak to these people through foreigners who talk in a language they cannot understand.

es.L: Porque con balbuceos de labios y con otra lengua \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hablará a este pueblo,
es.B: Pues con labios que balbucean y en lengua extranjera \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hablará a este pueblo,
es.R: Por eso ahora Dios hablará a esta gente por medio de extranjeros que hablan un idioma que no pueden entender.

fr.L: Car c’est avec des lèvres qui balbutient et dans une autre langue \q qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlera à ce peuple,
fr.B: Oui, c’est avec un parler hésitant et dans une langue étrangère \q qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlera à ce peuple,
fr.R: Alors maintenant, Dieu parlera à ce peuple par des étrangers qui parlent une langue qu’ils ne comprennent pas.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa midomo ya kigugumizi na kwa lugha nyingine \q atasema na watu hawa,
sw.B: Kweli, kwa maneno ya kigugumizi na kwa lugha ya kigeni \q atasema na watu hawa,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sasa Mungu atasema na watu hawa kupitia wageni wanaozungumza lugha wasiyoielewa.

vi.L: Vì bằng môi miệng lắp bắp và bằng một thứ tiếng khác, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phán với dân này,
vi.B: Thật vậy, bằng giọng nói ngập ngừng và bằng tiếng nước ngoài, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phán với dân này,
vi.R: Vì vậy bây giờ Đức Chúa Trời sẽ phán với dân này qua những người ngoại quốc nói một thứ tiếng họ không hiểu.

decisions.choice: stammering lips and another tongue: the speech of foreign invaders
decisions.reason: Since the leaders call God's message babble, God will speak to them in a language that really is babble to them: the speech of the Assyrian army (33:19; Deuteronomy 28:49). Judgment comes in a tongue they cannot follow.

decisions.choice: quoted in 1 Corinthians 14:21
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse, freely, to say that speaking in unknown tongues is a sign for unbelievers rather than a means of persuading them, much as the foreign speech here was a sign of judgment on a people who would not listen.

decisions.choice: God; through foreigners
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker and says how he speaks (m1).

decisions.choice: "midomo", "lugha nyingine", "atasema na watu hawa"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in 1 Corinthians 14:21, and the published Swahili there has "kwa lugha nyingine na kwa midomo ya wengine nitasema na watu hawa"; the same key words are kept.

decisions.choice: "tiếng khác"; "phán với dân này"
decisions.reason: Keeps the words of 1 Corinthians 14:21 ("tiếng khác", "phán với dân này") so that Paul's quotation can be recognised.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀אָמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֹ֤את הַמְּנוּחָה֙ הָנִ֣יחוּ לֶֽעָיֵ֔ף וְזֹ֖את הַמַּרְגֵּעָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּא שְׁמֽוֹעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: to whom he said, This [is] the rest, give rest to the weary, and this [is] the repose; and not they were willing to hear.

en.L: to whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "This [is] the rest; give rest to the weary; \q and this [is] the place of repose," \q but they were not willing to hear.
en.B: to whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} once said, "Here is rest: give the weary rest. Here is relief." \q But they refused to hear it.
en.R: He had told them, "This is the place where you can rest. Let tired people rest. This is where you will find relief." \q But they refused to listen.

es.L: a los cuales {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «Este [es] el reposo; {{plural_you:den|dad}} reposo al cansado; \q y este [es] el lugar de descanso», \q pero no quisieron escuchar.
es.B: a los cuales {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dicho: «Aquí está el reposo: {{plural_you:den|dad}} reposo al cansado. Aquí está el alivio». \q Pero se negaron a escucharlo.
es.R: Dios les había dicho: «Este es el lugar donde {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} descansar. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} descansar a los cansados. Aquí {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}} alivio». \q Pero se negaron a escuchar.

fr.L: auquel {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit : « Voici le repos ; donnez du repos à celui qui est las ; \q et voici le lieu du repos », \q mais ils n’ont pas voulu écouter.
fr.B: lui à qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit : « Voici le repos : laissez se reposer celui qui est fatigué. Voici le soulagement. » \q Mais ils ont refusé d’écouter.
fr.R: Il leur avait dit : « Voici l’endroit où vous pouvez vous reposer. Laissez se reposer ceux qui sont fatigués. Voici où vous trouverez du soulagement. » \q Mais ils ont refusé d’écouter.

sw.L: ambao aliwaambia, "Hii [ndiyo] raha; mpeni raha aliyechoka; \q na hapa [ndipo] mahali pa kupumzika," \q lakini hawakutaka kusikia.
sw.B: ambao aliwahi kuwaambia, "Hapa ndipo penye raha: wapeni raha waliochoka. Hapa ndipo penye nafuu." \q Lakini walikataa kusikia.
sw.R: Alikuwa amewaambia, "Hapa ndipo mahali mnapoweza kupumzika. Waacheni waliochoka wapumzike. Hapa ndipo mtakapopata nafuu." \q Lakini walikataa kusikiliza.

vi.L: là [dân] mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán: "Đây [là] sự nghỉ ngơi; hãy cho người mệt mỏi được nghỉ ngơi; \q và đây [là] chốn an nghỉ," \q nhưng họ đã không muốn nghe.
vi.B: là dân mà trước kia {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán: "Đây là sự nghỉ ngơi: hãy cho người mệt mỏi được nghỉ. Đây là nơi thư thái." \q Nhưng họ đã không chịu nghe.
vi.R: Ngài đã từng phán với họ: "Đây là nơi các ngươi được nghỉ ngơi. Hãy để người mệt mỏi được nghỉ. Đây là nơi các ngươi được thư thái." \q Nhưng họ không chịu nghe.

decisions.choice: rest, repose: the security God offered to those who trusted him
alternatives: the land as God's resting place for his people
decisions.reason: God had offered his people quiet safety in their land if they relied on him rather than on alliances and armies (7:4, 9; 30:15). The leaders turned it down; now they will hear foreign speech instead (verse 11).

decisions.choice: they refused to hear it
decisions.reason: The verb means they were not willing; "refused" says this plainly.

source.text: וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֜ם דְּבַר־יְהוָ֗ה צַ֣ו לָצָ֞ו צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ קַ֤ו לָקָו֙ קַ֣ו לָקָ֔ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֣יר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן יֵלְכ֜וּ וְכָשְׁל֤וּ אָחוֹר֙ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And it will be to them [the] word of Yahweh tsav latsav tsav latsav, qav laqav qav laqav, a little there, a little there, so that they may go and they will stumble backward and they will be broken and they will be snared and they will be captured.

en.L: And the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be to them tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q a little there, a little there, \q so that they will go and stumble backward, and be broken, \q and be snared, and be captured.
en.B: So the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will come to them as tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q a little here, a little there, \q so that they will walk on and fall backward, broken, \q trapped, and taken captive.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message to them will sound like babble: tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, a little here, a little there. \q Then they will go out and fall backward. They will be hurt, trapped, and captured.

es.L: Y la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} será para ellos tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q un poco allí, un poco allí, \q para que vayan y tropiecen hacia atrás, y sean quebrantados, \q y caigan en la trampa, y sean apresados.
es.B: Así la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} les llegará como tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q un poco aquí, un poco allá, \q para que sigan andando y caigan de espaldas, quebrantados, \q atrapados y llevados cautivos.
es.R: Por eso el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} les sonará como balbuceos: tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, un poco aquí, un poco allá. \q Entonces saldrán y caerán de espaldas. Quedarán heridos, atrapados y capturados.

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera pour eux tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q un peu ici, un peu ici, \q afin qu’ils marchent et trébuchent en arrière, et qu’ils soient brisés, \q pris au piège et capturés.
fr.B: Ainsi la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur viendra comme tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q un peu par-ci, un peu par-là, \q pour qu’ils avancent et tombent à la renverse, brisés, \q pris au piège et emmenés captifs.
fr.R: Alors le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera pour eux comme du charabia : tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, un peu par-ci, un peu par-là. \q Ils s’en iront et tomberont à la renverse. Ils seront blessés, pris au piège et capturés.

sw.L: Na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} litakuwa kwao tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q kidogo huko, kidogo huko, \q ili waende na kujikwaa kurudi nyuma, na kuvunjika, \q na kunaswa, na kutekwa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} litawajia kama tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q kidogo hapa, kidogo pale, \q ili waendelee kutembea na kuanguka chali, wavunjike, \q wanaswe na kuchukuliwa mateka.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwao utasikika kama maneno yasiyoeleweka: tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, kidogo hapa, kidogo pale. \q Kisha watatoka na kuanguka chali. Wataumia, watanaswa na kukamatwa.

vi.L: Và lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ là cho họ tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q một chút ở đây, một chút ở đó, \q để họ đi rồi ngã ngửa, và bị gãy, \q và bị sa bẫy, và bị bắt.
vi.B: Vì thế lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đến với họ như tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, \q chỗ này một chút, chỗ kia một chút, \q để họ cứ bước đi rồi ngã ngửa, bị gãy xương, \q sa vào bẫy và bị bắt làm tù binh.
vi.R: Vì vậy, sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho họ sẽ nghe như tiếng bập bẹ: tsav latsav, tsav latsav, qav laqav, qav laqav, chỗ này một chút, chỗ kia một chút. \q Rồi họ sẽ đi ra và ngã ngửa. Họ sẽ bị thương, bị sa bẫy và bị bắt.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD will be tsav latsav to them: the mockery turned back on the mockers
decisions.reason: The leaders called the prophet's message baby talk (verse 10). Now God's word will come to them exactly as they described it: incomprehensible, in the foreign speech of verse 11. See the note at verse 10 on the sounds.

decisions.choice: stumble, be broken, be snared, be captured: the same doom as 8:15
decisions.reason: The four verbs repeat 8:14-15, where the LORD is a stone that makes both houses of Israel stumble. The stone returns in verse 16.

decisions.choice: so that: the result God intends
decisions.reason: The conjunction expresses purpose or result. As in 6:9-10, refusing God's word leads to hardening and judgment.

decisions.choice: will sound like babble
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of repeating the chant (m1).

source.text: לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָצ֑וֹן מֹֽשְׁלֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore hear [the] word of Yahweh, men of scoffing, rulers of the people the this who [are] in Jerusalem.

en.L: Therefore hear [the] word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, men of scorn, \q rulers of this people who [are] in Jerusalem!
en.B: Now then, you men who sneer, \q you who govern this people in Jerusalem: listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says!
en.R: You leaders in Jerusalem who mock, listen now to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message!

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} [la] palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hombres burladores, \q gobernantes de este pueblo que [está] en Jerusalén.
es.B: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:ustedes, hombres burlones, ustedes|vosotros, hombres burlones, vosotros}} que gobiernan este pueblo en Jerusalén: \q ¡{{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}!
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes, jefes de Jerusalén que se burlan, escuchen|Vosotros, jefes de Jerusalén que os burláis, escuchad}} ahora este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, hommes de moquerie, \q dirigeants de ce peuple qui [est] à Jérusalem !
fr.B: Écoutez donc, vous qui ricanez, \q vous qui gouvernez ce peuple à Jérusalem : écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Vous, les chefs de Jérusalem qui vous moquez, écoutez maintenant le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Kwa hiyo sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu wa dharau, \q watawala wa watu hawa walio katika Yerusalemu!
sw.B: Basi sasa, enyi watu mnaodhihaki, \q ninyi mnaowatawala watu hawa katika Yerusalemu: sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Enyi viongozi wa Yerusalemu mnaodhihaki, sikilizeni sasa ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

vi.L: Vì vậy, hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi những kẻ nhạo báng, \q những kẻ cai trị dân này [ở] tại Giê-ru-sa-lem!
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hỡi những kẻ hay chế nhạo, \q hỡi các ngươi là những kẻ cai trị dân này tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Hỡi các nhà lãnh đạo hay chế giễu tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, bây giờ hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán!

decisions.choice: men of scorn: scoffers, those who mock what is holy
decisions.reason: In the wisdom books the scoffer is the one who will not be taught (Proverbs 1:22; 9:7-8). The word picks up the mocking of verses 9-10.

decisions.choice: rulers: those who govern, with a possible play on "makers of sayings"
alternatives: those who make proverbs about this people
decisions.reason: The same letters can mean "rule" or "make a proverb, a taunt". The leaders who rule are also the ones who coin mocking sayings like verse 10 and the boast of verse 15.

decisions.choice: Oigan la palabra del SEÑOR (L); Escuchen ... (B); Escuchen ahora este mensaje del SEÑOR (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms of "Hear the word of the LORD", as the terms note and 2 Kings 20:16, with plural_you.

decisions.choice: "sikieni neno la BWANA" (L); "sikilizeni neno la BWANA" (B); "sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: "Hear the word of the LORD" keeps the wording of 2 Kings 20:16 at each level throughout this block, as the terms note settles.

decisions.choice: "Écoutez la parole du SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "Écoutez le message du SEIGNEUR" (R), for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note.

decisions.choice: "hãy nghe lời của CHÚA" (L); "hãy nghe lời CHÚA" (B); "hãy nghe điều CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "hear the word of the LORD", as 2 Kings 20:16.

source.text: כִּ֣י אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כָּרַ֤תְנֽוּ בְרִית֙ אֶת־מָ֔וֶת וְעִם־שְׁא֖וֹל עָשִׂ֣ינוּ חֹזֶ֑ה שׁ֣וֹט שׁוֹטֵ֤ף כִּֽי־יַֽעֲבֹר֙ לֹ֣א יְבוֹאֵ֔נוּ כִּ֣י שַׂ֧מְנוּ כָזָ֛ב מַחְסֵ֖נוּ וּבַשֶּׁ֥קֶר נִסְתָּֽרְנוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For you have said, We have cut a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have made an agreement; [the] scourge overflowing, when it passes through, not it will come to us; for we have made lie our refuge, and in the falsehood we have hidden ourselves.

en.L: For you have said, "We have cut a covenant with death, \q and with Sheol we have made a pact; \q [the] overflowing whip, when it passes through, will not come to us, \q for we have made a lie our refuge, and in falsehood we have hidden ourselves."
en.B: For you have said, "We have made a covenant with death; \q we have a pact with Sheol. \q When the flooding whip sweeps through, it will not reach us, \q for we have taken shelter in a lie and hidden ourselves inside falsehood."
en.R: You have said, "We have made an agreement with death. \q We have a deal with the grave. \q When disaster floods through the land like a whip, it will not touch us. \q Our lies will keep us safe. Our tricks will hide us."

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}: «Hemos hecho pacto con la muerte, \q y con el Seol hemos hecho un convenio; \q el azote desbordante, cuando pase, no llegará a nosotros, \q porque hemos puesto la mentira por nuestro refugio, y en la falsedad nos hemos escondido».
es.B: Porque {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}: «Hemos hecho un pacto con la muerte; \q tenemos un convenio con el lugar de los muertos. \q Cuando pase el azote como una inundación, no nos alcanzará, \q porque nos hemos refugiado en la mentira y nos hemos escondido en el engaño».
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} dicho: «Hemos hecho un trato con la muerte. \q Tenemos un acuerdo con el lugar de los muertos. \q Cuando el desastre inunde la tierra como un látigo, no nos tocará. \q Nuestras mentiras nos mantendrán a salvo. Nuestros engaños nos esconderán».

fr.L: Car vous avez dit : « Nous avons conclu une alliance avec la mort, \q et avec le Shéol nous avons fait un pacte ; \q le fouet qui déborde, quand il passera, ne nous atteindra pas, \q car nous avons fait du mensonge notre refuge, et dans la fausseté nous nous sommes cachés. »
fr.B: Car vous avez dit : « Nous avons fait alliance avec la mort ; \q nous avons un pacte avec le séjour des morts. \q Quand le fouet déferlera, il ne nous atteindra pas, \q car nous avons pris le mensonge pour abri et la fausseté pour cachette. »
fr.R: Vous avez dit : « Nous avons fait un accord avec la mort. \q Nous avons un arrangement avec le séjour des morts. \q Quand le malheur inondera le pays comme un coup de fouet, il ne nous touchera pas. \q Nos mensonges nous protégeront. Nos ruses nous cacheront. »

sw.L: Kwa maana mmesema, "Tumefanya agano na kifo, \q na pamoja na Kuzimu tumefanya mapatano; \q mjeledi unaofurika, utakapopita, hautatufikia, \q kwa maana tumeufanya uongo kuwa kimbilio letu, na katika udanganyifu tumejificha."
sw.B: Kwa maana mmesema, "Tumefanya agano na kifo; \q tuna mapatano na Kuzimu. \q Mjeledi unaofurika utakapopita, hautatufikia, \q kwa maana tumejikinga ndani ya uongo na kujificha ndani ya udanganyifu."
sw.R: Mmesema, "Tumefanya makubaliano na kifo. \q Tuna mapatano na Kuzimu. \q Maafa yatakapopita katika nchi kama mafuriko, kama mjeledi, hayatatugusa. \q Uongo wetu utatulinda. Hila zetu zitatuficha."

vi.L: Vì các ngươi đã nói: "Chúng ta đã kết giao ước với sự chết, \q và với Âm Phủ chúng ta đã lập hiệp ước; \q ngọn roi tràn lan, khi nó đi qua, sẽ không đến với chúng ta, \q vì chúng ta đã lấy sự dối trá làm nơi ẩn náu, và trong sự giả dối chúng ta đã ẩn mình."
vi.B: Vì các ngươi đã nói: "Chúng ta đã lập giao ước với sự chết; \q chúng ta có hiệp ước với Âm Phủ. \q Khi ngọn roi như nước lũ quét qua, nó sẽ không chạm đến chúng ta, \q vì chúng ta đã núp trong sự dối trá và ẩn mình trong sự giả dối."
vi.R: Các ngươi đã nói: "Chúng ta đã thỏa thuận với sự chết. \q Chúng ta đã giao kèo với nơi của người chết. \q Khi tai họa tràn qua xứ như ngọn roi quất xuống, nó sẽ không đụng đến chúng ta. \q Những lời dối trá sẽ giữ chúng ta an toàn. Những mưu mẹo sẽ che giấu chúng ta."

decisions.choice: a covenant with death, a pact with Sheol: a treaty the leaders trusted to keep them from destruction
alternatives: rites to win protection from the powers of death
decisions.reason: The leaders boast of an agreement that will protect them when the invader floods the land. Isaiah gives it a mocking name. It most likely means their alliance with Egypt against Assyria (30:1-3; 31:1), bound by oaths before gods. It may also hint at seeking help from the dead or from the god of death (8:19). Either way, what they thought protected them from death was a bargain with death itself.

decisions.choice: pact: an agreement
decisions.reason: The word is normally "seer" or "vision". Here, parallel to "covenant", it means a binding agreement, perhaps one confirmed by a seer's word. It returns in verse 18.

decisions.choice: whip; passes through: the qere
decisions.reason: The written consonants have a different spelling of "whip" and a past form, "passed through"; the scribes' marginal reading gives "whip" in its usual spelling and a future, "will pass through", as in verse 18. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the flooding whip; a lie, falsehood
decisions.reason: Two pictures of Assyria are joined: the flood of 8:7-8 and the whip of 10:26. The leaders would not have called their shelter "a lie"; the prophet puts his verdict on their plan into their own mouths.

decisions.choice: agreement; the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says "agreement" for covenant and "the grave" for Sheol (settled wording).

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is "el Seol" at L and "el lugar de los muertos" at B and R, as the Pentateuch and Psalms notes, though the English B keeps "Sheol".

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" at every level
decisions.reason: Sheol is "Kuzimu" at every level, as the Psalms note and the terms note settle, though the English Readable says "the grave"; "Kuzimu" is already the plain Swahili word for the world of the dead.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" (L), "le séjour des morts" (B, R), for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note, the Psalms and Proverbs; the English Readable "the grave" is the same place.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for Sheol, as Psalm 139:8 and Proverbs 9:18; used unchanged through these chapters.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֛י יִסַּ֥ד בְּצִיּ֖וֹן אָ֑בֶן אֶ֣בֶן בֹּ֜חַן פִּנַּ֤ת יִקְרַת֙ מוּסָ֣ד מוּסָּ֔ד הַֽמַּאֲמִ֖ין לֹ֥א יָחִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Look, I [am the one who] has laid in Zion a stone, a stone of testing, a corner of preciousness of a foundation founded; the [one who] trusts not he will hurry.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: \q Look, I [am the one who] has laid in Zion a stone, \q a stone of testing, a precious corner[stone] of a foundation firmly founded; \q the [one who] trusts will not hurry.
en.B: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: \q Look, I have laid a stone in Zion as its foundation: \q a stone proven by testing, a valuable cornerstone, set deep and secure. \q The one who trusts will not rush in panic.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: \q Look! I have set a stone in Zion as a foundation. \q It is a stone that has been tested. It is a valuable cornerstone that holds the building firm. \q Anyone who trusts will not panic and run.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: \q He aquí, yo [soy el que] ha puesto en Sion una piedra, \q piedra probada, angular, preciosa, de cimiento bien cimentado; \q el que crea no se apresurará.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Mira, he puesto en Sion una piedra como cimiento: \q una piedra probada, una valiosa piedra angular, asentada firme y segura. \q El que confíe no huirá con pánico.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: \q ¡Mira! He puesto en Sion una piedra como cimiento. \q Es una piedra que ha sido probada. Es una valiosa piedra angular que mantiene firme el edificio. \q Quien confíe no se asustará ni saldrá corriendo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : \q Voici, j’ai posé en Sion une pierre, \q une pierre éprouvée, une [pierre] d’angle précieuse d’un fondement solidement fondé ; \q celui qui se confie ne se hâtera pas.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Voici, j’ai posé en Sion une pierre pour fondation : \q une pierre éprouvée, une pierre angulaire de prix, posée profond et solide. \q Celui qui se confie ne fuira pas dans la panique.
fr.R: Voici donc ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : \q Regardez ! J’ai placé une pierre en Sion comme fondation. \q C’est une pierre qui a été mise à l’épreuve. C’est une pierre d’angle précieuse qui tient toute la construction. \q Celui qui a confiance ne paniquera pas et ne s’enfuira pas.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Tazama, mimi [ndiye] niliyeweka katika Sayuni jiwe, \q jiwe la kujaribiwa, [jiwe] la pembeni la thamani la msingi uliowekwa imara; \q yeye anayeamini hataharakisha.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Tazama, nimeweka jiwe katika Sayuni kuwa msingi wake: \q jiwe lililothibitishwa kwa kujaribiwa, jiwe kuu la pembeni lenye thamani, lililowekwa chini kwa uthabiti. \q Yeye anayeamini hatakimbia kwa hofu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Tazama! Nimeweka jiwe katika Sayuni kuwa msingi. \q Ni jiwe lililojaribiwa. Ni jiwe kuu la pembeni lenye thamani linaloshikilia jengo imara. \q Yeyote anayeamini hatababaika na kukimbia.

vi.L: Vì vậy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Kìa, Ta [là Đấng] đã đặt tại Si-ôn một hòn đá, \q một hòn đá đã thử nghiệm, đá góc nhà quý báu của một nền móng vững chắc; \q người tin cậy sẽ không vội vã.
vi.B: Vì thế Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Kìa, Ta đã đặt một hòn đá tại Si-ôn làm nền móng: \q một hòn đá đã được thử nghiệm, một đá góc nhà quý báu, được đặt sâu và vững chắc. \q Người tin cậy sẽ không hoảng hốt vội vàng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Hãy xem! Ta đã đặt một hòn đá tại Si-ôn làm nền móng. \q Đó là hòn đá đã được thử nghiệm. Đó là đá góc nhà quý báu giữ cho cả ngôi nhà vững chắc. \q Ai tin cậy sẽ không hoảng sợ bỏ chạy.

decisions.choice: a tested, precious cornerstone in Zion: what God himself has founded, in contrast to the leaders' shelter of lies
decisions.reason: Against the false refuge of verse 15, God sets a true foundation in Zion. The stone stands for what God has established there: his promise to Zion and to David's line (2 Samuel 7:16; Isaiah 8:14; 14:32), to be received by trust (7:9). The New Testament applies the verse to Jesus as the cornerstone (Romans 9:33; 1 Peter 2:6; compare Ephesians 2:20).

decisions.choice: I am the one who has laid: a completed act
decisions.reason: Hebrew reads "Look, I, he has laid", a relative clause: God is the one who laid the stone. The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) is reported to read a participle, "I am laying", and the Septuagint has a future, "I will lay". The received text is kept.

decisions.choice: will not hurry: will not run in panic
alternatives: will not be put to shame (Septuagint)
decisions.reason: The verb means to hurry. The one who trusts will stay calm and not flee in alarm (compare 30:15-16). The Septuagint has "will not be put to shame", and Romans 9:33; 10:11 and 1 Peter 2:6 quote that form. Neither "trusts" nor "hurry" has a stated object; the context implies trust in God and in what he has founded.

decisions.choice: "jiwe kuu la pembeni"; "anayeamini"
decisions.reason: The verse is quoted in 1 Peter 2:6 and Romans 9:33; the published Swahili there has "jiwe kuu la pembeni" and "anayemwamini", so these key words are kept, while the end of the verse follows the Hebrew ("will not hurry"), not the Greek ("will not be put to shame").

decisions.choice: "pierre éprouvée", "pierre d'angle précieuse" at every level
decisions.reason: Romans 9:33 and 1 Peter 2:6 quote this verse; French keeps the cornerstone and its worth so the quotation can be seen, translating from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "đá góc nhà"; "đặt tại Si-ôn một hòn đá"
decisions.reason: Keeps the terms of 1 Peter 2:6 and Romans 9:33 in Vietnamese, so a reader can see the quotation; the rest is drafted from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này:" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy:" (B); "Đây là lời CHÚA phán:" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "Thus says the LORD", followed by a colon and no quotation marks; used unchanged through these chapters.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְקָ֔ו וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְמִשְׁקָ֑לֶת וְיָעָ֤ה בָרָד֙ מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב וְסֵ֥תֶר מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make justice for a line and righteousness for a level, and it will sweep away hail [the] refuge of lie, and [the] hiding place waters they will overflow.

en.L: And I will make justice [the] measuring line \q and righteousness [the] level; \q and hail will sweep away [the] refuge of lies, \q and waters will overflow [the] hiding place.
en.B: Justice will be my measuring line, \q and righteousness my plumb line. \q Hail will sweep away the shelter of lies, \q and floodwaters will swamp the hiding place.
en.R: I will use justice and righteousness like a builder's measuring line and level. \q Hail will sweep away the lies you hide behind. \q Floods will cover your hiding place.

es.L: Y pondré el derecho por cordel \q y la justicia por nivel; \q y el granizo barrerá el refugio de la mentira, \q y las aguas inundarán el escondite.
es.B: El derecho será mi cordel de medir, \q y la justicia mi plomada. \q El granizo barrerá el refugio de mentiras, \q y las aguas anegarán el escondite.
es.R: Usaré la justicia y la rectitud como el cordel de medir y el nivel de un constructor. \q El granizo barrerá las mentiras detrás de las cuales {{plural_you:se esconden|os escondéis}}. \q Las inundaciones cubrirán {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} escondite.

fr.L: Et je ferai du droit le cordeau \q et de la justice le niveau ; \q et la grêle balaiera le refuge du mensonge, \q et les eaux submergeront la cachette.
fr.B: Le droit sera mon cordeau, \q et la justice mon fil à plomb. \q La grêle balaiera l’abri de mensonges, \q et les eaux en crue noieront la cachette.
fr.R: Je me servirai du droit et de la justice comme un maçon se sert du cordeau et du niveau. \q La grêle emportera les mensonges derrière lesquels vous vous cachez. \q Les inondations recouvriront votre cachette.

sw.L: Nami nitaifanya hukumu kuwa kamba ya kupimia, \q na haki kuwa timazi; \q na mvua ya mawe itakifagilia mbali kimbilio la uongo, \q na maji yatafurika mahali pa kujificha.
sw.B: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba yangu ya kupimia, \q na uadilifu kuwa timazi yangu. \q Mvua ya mawe itakifagilia mbali kimbilio la uongo, \q na mafuriko yatagharikisha mahali pa kujificha.
sw.R: Nitatumia haki na uadilifu kama fundi anavyotumia kamba ya kupimia na timazi. \q Mvua ya mawe itafagilia mbali uongo mnaojificha nyuma yake. \q Mafuriko yatafunika mahali penu pa kujificha.

vi.L: Và Ta sẽ lấy công lý làm dây đo \q và sự công chính làm dây dọi; \q và mưa đá sẽ quét sạch nơi ẩn náu bằng sự dối trá, \q và nước sẽ tràn ngập nơi ẩn núp.
vi.B: Công lý sẽ là dây đo của Ta, \q và sự công chính là dây dọi của Ta. \q Mưa đá sẽ cuốn phăng nơi trú ẩn bằng dối trá, \q và nước lũ sẽ nhấn chìm nơi ẩn núp.
vi.R: Ta sẽ dùng công lý và điều công chính như người thợ xây dùng dây đo và dây dọi. \q Mưa đá sẽ quét sạch những lời dối trá mà các ngươi núp sau. \q Nước lũ sẽ nhấn chìm nơi các ngươi ẩn náu.

decisions.choice: measuring line, level: the builder's tools for checking that work is straight and true
decisions.reason: God builds with the cornerstone of verse 16 and tests everything by justice and righteousness. The word for line is qav, heard in the mockery of verses 10 and 13; it now becomes the line of God's judgment (34:11; 2 Kings 21:13).

decisions.choice: hail and flood sweep away the refuge of lies
decisions.reason: The storm of verse 2 and the flooding whip of verse 15 destroy the shelter the leaders made of falsehood. Hail also recalls the battle near Gibeon (verse 21; Joshua 10:11).

decisions.choice: you hide behind; your hiding place
decisions.reason: Readable says whose refuge it is: the leaders' of verse 15.

decisions.choice: "hukumu ... haki" (L); "haki ... uadilifu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: When mishpat and tsedaqah stand together, Literal keeps "hukumu" and "haki" as the terms note sets them; Balanced and Readable, where mishpat is "haki", use "uadilifu" for the second word so that the pair does not repeat one word. "Timazi" (plumb line) is the word of 2 Kings 21:13.

source.text: וְכֻפַּ֤ר בְּרִֽיתְכֶם֙ אֶת־מָ֔וֶת וְחָזוּתְכֶ֥ם אֶת־שְׁא֖וֹל לֹ֣א תָק֑וּם שׁ֤וֹט שׁוֹטֵף֙ כִּ֣י יַֽעֲבֹ֔ר וִהְיִ֥יתֶם ל֖וֹ לְמִרְמָֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be covered over your covenant with death, and your agreement with Sheol not it will stand; [the] scourge overflowing, when it passes through, and you will be for it for a trampling.

en.L: And your covenant with death will be wiped out, \q and your pact with Sheol will not stand; \q [the] overflowing whip, when it passes through, \q you will be for it [a place of] trampling.
en.B: Your covenant with death will be wiped out, \q and your pact with Sheol will fail. \q When the flooding whip sweeps through, \q it will trample you into the ground.
en.R: Your agreement with death will be canceled. \q Your deal with the grave will not last. \q When disaster floods through like a whip, \q it will crush you.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} pacto con la muerte será anulado, \q y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} convenio con el Seol no se mantendrá; \q el azote desbordante, cuando pase, \q {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} para él [lugar de] pisoteo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} pacto con la muerte quedará anulado, \q y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} convenio con el lugar de los muertos fracasará. \q Cuando pase el azote como una inundación, \q {{plural_you:los|os}} aplastará contra el suelo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} trato con la muerte será cancelado. \q {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} acuerdo con el lugar de los muertos no durará. \q Cuando el desastre pase inundándolo todo como un látigo, \q {{plural_you:los|os}} aplastará.

fr.L: Et votre alliance avec la mort sera effacée, \q et votre pacte avec le Shéol ne tiendra pas ; \q le fouet qui déborde, quand il passera, \q vous serez pour lui [un lieu] piétiné.
fr.B: Votre alliance avec la mort sera annulée, \q et votre pacte avec le séjour des morts ne tiendra pas. \q Quand le fouet déferlera, \q il vous piétinera.
fr.R: Votre accord avec la mort sera annulé. \q Votre arrangement avec le séjour des morts ne durera pas. \q Quand le malheur arrivera comme un coup de fouet, \q il vous écrasera.

sw.L: Na agano lenu na kifo litafutwa, \q na mapatano yenu na Kuzimu hayatasimama; \q mjeledi unaofurika, utakapopita, \q mtakuwa kwake [mahali pa] kukanyagwa.
sw.B: Agano lenu na kifo litafutwa, \q na mapatano yenu na Kuzimu yatashindwa. \q Mjeledi unaofurika utakapopita, \q utawakanyaga mpaka chini.
sw.R: Makubaliano yenu na kifo yatavunjwa. \q Mapatano yenu na Kuzimu hayatadumu. \q Maafa yatakapopita kama mafuriko, kama mjeledi, \q yatawaponda.

vi.L: Và giao ước của các ngươi với sự chết sẽ bị xóa bỏ, \q và hiệp ước của các ngươi với Âm Phủ sẽ không đứng vững; \q ngọn roi tràn lan, khi nó đi qua, \q các ngươi sẽ bị nó giày đạp.
vi.B: Giao ước của các ngươi với sự chết sẽ bị hủy bỏ, \q và hiệp ước của các ngươi với Âm Phủ sẽ đổ vỡ. \q Khi ngọn roi như nước lũ quét qua, \q nó sẽ giày đạp các ngươi xuống đất.
vi.R: Sự thỏa thuận của các ngươi với sự chết sẽ bị hủy bỏ. \q Sự giao kèo của các ngươi với nơi của người chết sẽ không còn. \q Khi tai họa tràn qua như ngọn roi quất xuống, \q nó sẽ đè bẹp các ngươi.

decisions.choice: wiped out: annulled, made void
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "cover" or "atone". Here it means to cancel or wipe out, as an agreement is annulled.

decisions.choice: you will be trampled: the boast of verse 15 reversed
decisions.reason: The leaders said the flooding whip would not reach them; it will pass through and leave them trampled, like the crown of Ephraim (verse 3).

source.text: מִדֵּ֤י עָבְרוֹ֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־בַבֹּ֧קֶר בַּבֹּ֛קֶר יַעֲבֹ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה רַק־זְוָעָ֖ה הָבִ֥ין שְׁמוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: As often as it passes through it will take you, for in the morning, in the morning it will pass through, in the day and in the night; and it will be only terror to understand [the] message.

en.L: As often as it passes through, it will seize you, \q for in the morning, in the morning, it will pass through, in the day and in the night; \q and it will be only terror to grasp [the] message.
en.B: Each time it comes through, it will seize you. \q It will come through every morning, by day and by night. \q When at last you grasp the message, it will be only terror.
en.R: It will come again and again, every morning, every day and every night, and it will carry you away. \q When you finally understand this message, you will be terrified.

es.L: Cada vez que pase, {{plural_you:los|os}} arrebatará, \q porque mañana tras mañana pasará, de día y de noche; \q y será puro terror entender [el] mensaje.
es.B: Cada vez que pase, {{plural_you:los|os}} arrebatará. \q Pasará cada mañana, de día y de noche. \q Cuando por fin {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} el mensaje, será solo terror.
es.R: Vendrá una y otra vez, cada mañana, cada día y cada noche, y {{plural_you:se los|os}} llevará. \q Cuando por fin {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} este mensaje, {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} aterrados.

fr.L: Chaque fois qu’il passera, il vous saisira, \q car matin après matin il passera, de jour et de nuit ; \q et ce ne sera que terreur de comprendre le message.
fr.B: Chaque fois qu’il passera, il vous emportera. \q Il passera chaque matin, de jour comme de nuit. \q Quand enfin vous comprendrez le message, ce ne sera que terreur.
fr.R: Il reviendra encore et encore, chaque matin, chaque jour et chaque nuit, et il vous emportera. \q Quand vous comprendrez enfin ce message, vous serez terrifiés.

sw.L: Kila mara utakapopita, utawachukua, \q kwa maana asubuhi baada ya asubuhi utapita, mchana na usiku; \q na itakuwa hofu tupu kuufahamu ujumbe.
sw.B: Kila mara unapopita, utawakamata. \q Utapita kila asubuhi, mchana na usiku. \q Mtakapoufahamu ujumbe hatimaye, itakuwa hofu tupu.
sw.R: Yatakuja tena na tena, kila asubuhi, kila mchana na kila usiku, na yatawachukua. \q Mtakapoufahamu ujumbe huu hatimaye, mtaogopa sana.

vi.L: Mỗi khi nó đi qua, nó sẽ bắt lấy các ngươi, \q vì sáng này qua sáng khác nó sẽ đi qua, ban ngày và ban đêm; \q và hiểu được sứ điệp sẽ chỉ là nỗi kinh hoàng.
vi.B: Mỗi lần nó quét qua, nó sẽ bắt các ngươi đi. \q Sáng nào nó cũng quét qua, ngày cũng như đêm. \q Khi rốt cuộc các ngươi hiểu sứ điệp, đó sẽ chỉ là nỗi kinh hoàng.
vi.R: Nó sẽ đến hết lần này đến lần khác, mỗi buổi sáng, mỗi ngày và mỗi đêm, và nó sẽ bắt các ngươi đi. \q Khi cuối cùng các ngươi hiểu sứ điệp này, các ngươi sẽ kinh hãi.

decisions.choice: to understand the message: the message the leaders scorned
alternatives: merely hearing the report will cause terror
decisions.reason: Verse 9 asked mockingly whom the prophet could "make understand the message". The leaders will understand at last, when the invasion comes, and understanding will be nothing but terror.

decisions.choice: morning by morning: again and again, without relief
decisions.reason: The repeated phrase means every day; day and night the invader returns.

source.text: כִּֽי־קָצַ֥ר הַמַּצָּ֖ע מֵֽהִשְׂתָּרֵ֑עַ וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה צָ֖רָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: For it is short the bed for stretching oneself out, and the covering it is narrow as wrapping oneself.

en.L: For the bed is short for stretching oneself out, \q and the covering [is] narrow for wrapping oneself.
en.B: The bed is too short for anyone to stretch out on it, \q and the blanket too skimpy to wrap up in.
en.R: You will be like someone with a bed too short to lie down on \q and a blanket too small to cover up with. Your plans will not give you rest or protection.

es.L: Porque la cama es corta para estirarse, \q y la manta, estrecha para envolverse.
es.B: La cama es demasiado corta para estirarse en ella, \q y la manta demasiado angosta para envolverse.
es.R: {{plural_you:Serán|Seréis}} como alguien que tiene una cama demasiado corta para acostarse \q y una manta demasiado pequeña para taparse. {{plural_you:Sus planes no les|Vuestros planes no os}} darán descanso ni protección.

fr.L: Car le lit est trop court pour s’étendre, \q et la couverture trop étroite pour s’envelopper.
fr.B: Le lit est trop court pour qu’on s’y allonge, \q et la couverture trop étroite pour qu’on s’y enroule.
fr.R: Vous serez comme quelqu’un qui a un lit trop court pour s’y coucher \q et une couverture trop petite pour s’y couvrir. Vos projets ne vous donneront ni repos ni protection.

sw.L: Kwa maana kitanda ni kifupi mtu asiweze kujinyoosha, \q na shuka [ni] nyembamba mtu asiweze kujifunika.
sw.B: Kitanda ni kifupi mno mtu asiweze kujinyoosha juu yake, \q na blanketi ni dogo mno kujifunika.
sw.R: Mtakuwa kama mtu mwenye kitanda kifupi mno kulalia \q na blanketi dogo mno kujifunika. Mipango yenu haitawapa raha wala ulinzi.

vi.L: Vì giường quá ngắn để duỗi mình ra, \q và chăn quá hẹp để quấn mình.
vi.B: Giường quá ngắn, không ai duỗi người được, \q và chăn quá hẹp, không quấn mình được.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ giống như người có cái giường quá ngắn không nằm được, \q và cái chăn quá nhỏ không đắp được. Những kế hoạch của các ngươi sẽ không đem lại cho các ngươi sự nghỉ ngơi hay sự che chở.

decisions.choice: a bed too short, a blanket too narrow: the leaders' arrangements will not give them the rest they want
decisions.reason: This sounds like a proverb. The shelter they made (verse 15) will leave them as uncomfortable and exposed as a sleeper who cannot stretch out or keep warm. It contrasts with the rest God offered (verse 12).

decisions.choice: You will be like someone ...; Your plans will not give you rest or protection.
decisions.reason: Readable says who the proverb is about and explains the picture (m1).

source.text: כִּ֤י כְהַר־פְּרָצִים֙ יָק֣וּם יְהוָ֔ה כְּעֵ֖מֶק בְּגִבְע֣וֹן יִרְגָּ֑ז לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֨הוּ֙ זָ֣ר מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ נָכְרִיָּ֖ה עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For like [at] Mount Perazim he will rise Yahweh, like [in the] valley in Gibeon he will rage, to do his deed, strange [is] his deed, and to work his work, foreign [is] his work.

en.L: For like [at] Mount Perazim {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rise up; \q like [in the] valley in Gibeon {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rage, \q to do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deed, strange [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deed, \q and to work {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work, foreign [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work.
en.B: As at Mount Perazim, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will stand up; \q as in the valley near Gibeon, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burst into fury, \q to do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deed, a strange deed, \q and to carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work, an alien work.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will get up and fight, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did at Mount Perazim. \q He will be angry, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was in the valley near Gibeon. \q He will do a strange thing. He will do an unexpected work.

es.L: Porque como [en el] monte Perazim se levantará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q como [en el] valle de Gabaón {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enfurecerá, \q para hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra, extraña [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra, \q y para realizar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tarea, insólita [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tarea.
es.B: Como en el monte Perazim, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se pondrá en pie; \q como en el valle junto a Gabaón, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estallará en furia, \q para hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra, una obra extraña, \q y para llevar a cabo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tarea, una tarea insólita.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se levantará a pelear, como lo hizo en el monte Perazim. \q Se enojará, como se enojó en el valle cerca de Gabaón. \q Hará algo extraño. Hará una obra inesperada.

fr.L: Car comme [au] mont Peratsim, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se lèvera ; \q comme [dans] la vallée de Gabaon, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} frémira de colère, \q pour faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} œuvre, étrange [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} œuvre, \q et pour accomplir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail, insolite [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail.
fr.B: Comme au mont Peratsim, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se lèvera ; \q comme dans la vallée près de Gabaon, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} éclatera de colère, \q pour faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} œuvre, une œuvre étrange, \q et pour accomplir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail, un travail insolite.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se lèvera pour combattre, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait au mont Peratsim. \q Il se mettra en colère, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait dans la vallée près de Gabaon. \q Il fera une chose étrange. Il fera un travail inattendu.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama [kwenye] mlima Perasimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atainuka; \q kama [katika] bonde lililoko Gibeoni ataghadhibika, \q ili kufanya kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [ni] ngeni, \q na kutenda tendo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, tendo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} [ni] la kigeni.
sw.B: Kama ilivyokuwa mlimani Perasimu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atasimama; \q kama katika bonde karibu na Gibeoni, atawaka kwa ghadhabu, \q ili kufanya kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kazi ngeni, \q na kutimiza tendo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, tendo la kigeni.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atainuka kupigana, kama alivyofanya mlimani Perasimu. \q Atakasirika, kama alivyokasirika katika bonde karibu na Gibeoni. \q Atafanya jambo geni. Atafanya kazi isiyotarajiwa.

vi.L: Vì như [tại] núi Phê-ra-xim, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trỗi dậy; \q như [tại] thung lũng ở Ga-ba-ôn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nổi giận, \q để làm công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thật] lạ lùng, \q và để thực hiện việc làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, việc làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thật] khác thường.
vi.B: Như tại núi Phê-ra-xim, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đứng lên; \q như trong thung lũng gần Ga-ba-ôn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bừng bừng nổi giận, \q để làm công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, một công việc lạ lùng, \q và để thực hiện việc làm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, một việc làm khác thường.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đứng lên chiến đấu như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tại núi Phê-ra-xim. \q Ngài sẽ nổi giận như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận trong thung lũng gần Ga-ba-ôn. \q Ngài sẽ làm một việc lạ lùng. Ngài sẽ làm một việc không ai ngờ.

decisions.choice: Mount Perazim and the valley at Gibeon: places where the LORD fought for Israel
decisions.reason: At Baal-perazim the LORD broke through the Philistines for David (2 Samuel 5:20; 1 Chronicles 14:11), and David struck them from Gibeon on (1 Chronicles 14:16). At Gibeon the LORD also threw down hailstones on Israel's enemies for Joshua (Joshua 10:10-14; compare verse 17).

decisions.choice: strange deed, alien work: this time the LORD fights against his own people
decisions.reason: In those battles God fought for Israel. Now he will rise up in the same way against the rulers of Jerusalem (verses 14, 22), a work that seems foreign to him.

decisions.choice: get up and fight
decisions.reason: Readable says what rising up means here (m1).

decisions.choice: "núi Phê-ra-xim"
decisions.reason: The place is Baal-perazim of 2 Samuel 5:20 and 1 Chronicles 14:11, published as "Ba-anh Phê-ra-xim"; the second part is kept in the same form.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־תִּתְלוֹצָ֔צוּ פֶּֽן־יֶחְזְק֖וּ מֽוֹסְרֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־כָלָ֨ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now not you should show yourselves mockers, lest they become strong your bonds; for a full end and decreed I have heard from [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts upon all the land.

en.L: And now, do not show yourselves mockers, \q lest your bonds be made strong; \q for a full end, and [one] decreed, I have heard from the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts upon all the land.
en.B: Now then, give up your scoffing, \q or your chains will grip you harder. \q For I have heard from the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies of an end, complete and decreed, coming upon the whole land.
en.R: So stop mocking, or your trouble will get worse, like chains pulled tighter. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies has told me that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has decided to destroy the whole land completely.

es.L: Y ahora, no {{plural_you:se muestren|os mostréis}} burladores, \q no sea que se hagan más fuertes {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ataduras; \q porque una destrucción completa y decretada he oído del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos sobre toda la tierra.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:dejen de burlarse|dejad de burlaros}}, \q o {{plural_you:sus cadenas los|vuestras cadenas os}} apretarán más. \q Porque he oído del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos un fin completo y decretado que viene sobre toda la tierra.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:dejen de burlarse, o sus problemas empeorarán|dejad de burlaros, o vuestros problemas empeorarán}}, como cadenas que se aprietan más. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos me ha dicho que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha decidido destruir por completo toda la tierra.

fr.L: Et maintenant, ne vous montrez pas moqueurs, \q de peur que vos liens ne se resserrent ; \q car une destruction complète, et décrétée, je l’ai entendue de la part du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, sur tout le pays.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, cessez vos moqueries, \q sinon vos chaînes vous serreront plus fort. \q Car j’ai appris du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées qu’une destruction complète et décrétée va venir sur tout le pays.
fr.R: Alors arrêtez de vous moquer, sinon vos malheurs vont empirer, comme des chaînes qu’on serre davantage. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées m’a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a décidé de détruire complètement tout le pays.

sw.L: Na sasa, msijionyeshe kuwa wenye dhihaka, \q vifungo vyenu visije vikakazwa; \q kwa maana mwisho kamili, na ulioamriwa, nimeusikia kutoka kwa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi juu ya nchi yote.
sw.B: Basi sasa, acheni dhihaka zenu, \q la sivyo minyororo yenu itawabana zaidi. \q Kwa maana nimesikia kutoka kwa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi habari ya mwisho kamili ulioamriwa, unaokuja juu ya nchi yote.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo acheni kudhihaki, la sivyo taabu yenu itazidi, kama minyororo inayokazwa zaidi. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameniambia kwamba ameamua kuiangamiza nchi yote kabisa.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, các người đừng làm kẻ nhạo báng nữa, \q kẻo xiềng xích của các người bị siết chặt thêm; \q vì sự kết thúc trọn vẹn và đã được định, tôi đã nghe từ Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân trên khắp xứ.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy thôi chế nhạo, \q kẻo xiềng xích của các người càng siết chặt hơn. \q Vì tôi đã nghe từ Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân về một sự kết thúc trọn vẹn và đã được định, sẽ đến trên khắp xứ.
vi.R: Vậy hãy thôi chế giễu, kẻo tai họa của các người càng nặng hơn, như xiềng xích bị siết chặt thêm. \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã cho tôi biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quyết định hủy diệt hoàn toàn cả xứ.

decisions.choice: a full end, decreed: the same words as 10:23
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats 10:22-23, where the full end decreed in the land leaves only a remnant (compare verse 5).

decisions.choice: all the land: Judah's land
decisions.reason: The word can mean the whole earth or one land. Here the warning is to the rulers of Jerusalem, so the land of Judah is most likely meant, as in 10:23.

decisions.choice: your bonds be made strong: your punishment be made heavier
decisions.reason: Bonds or chains picture the judgment closing in like a captive's fetters; scoffing will only tighten them.

decisions.choice: "các người" here
decisions.reason: In this verse the prophet speaks in his own voice ("I have heard"), so he rebukes the leaders with "các người", as the terms note sets; God's oracle in verses 14-21 says "các ngươi".

source.text: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ קוֹלִ֑י הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אִמְרָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my speech.

en.L: Give ear and hear my voice; \q pay attention and hear my speech.
en.B: Turn your ear and hear my voice; \q take note and listen to what I say.
en.R: Listen to me! Hear what I am saying. \q Pay attention to my words.

es.L: {{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} oído y {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} mi voz; \q {{plural_you:atiendan|atended}} y {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} mi palabra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Inclinen|Inclinad}} el oído y {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} mi voz; \q {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} atención y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que digo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}! {{plural_you:Oigan lo que les digo|Oíd lo que os digo}}. \q {{plural_you:Presten|Prestad}} atención a mis palabras.

fr.L: Prêtez l’oreille et écoutez ma voix ; \q soyez attentifs et écoutez ma parole.
fr.B: Tendez l’oreille et entendez ma voix ; \q faites attention et écoutez ce que je dis.
fr.R: Écoutez-moi ! Entendez ce que je dis. \q Faites attention à mes paroles.

sw.L: Tegeni sikio mkaisikie sauti yangu; \q sikilizeni kwa makini mkayasikie maneno yangu.
sw.B: Tegeni masikio msikie sauti yangu; \q zingatieni na kusikiliza ninayosema.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni! Sikieni ninachosema. \q Yazingatieni maneno yangu.

vi.L: Hãy lắng tai và nghe tiếng tôi; \q hãy chú ý và nghe lời tôi nói.
vi.B: Hãy lắng tai nghe tiếng tôi; \q hãy để ý và nghe điều tôi nói.
vi.R: Hãy lắng nghe tôi! Hãy nghe điều tôi nói. \q Hãy chú ý đến lời tôi.

decisions.choice: give ear, pay attention: a teacher's call to listen
decisions.reason: Wisdom teachers open a lesson this way (Proverbs 4:1; 5:1; compare Isaiah 32:9). The prophet speaks in his own voice and tells a parable about a farmer (verses 23-29).

source.text: הֲכֹ֣ל הַיּ֔וֹם יַחֲרֹ֥שׁ הַחֹרֵ֖שׁ לִזְרֹ֑עַ יְפַתַּ֥ח וִֽישַׂדֵּ֖ד אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: All the day does he plow, the plowman, to sow? Does he open and harrow his ground?

en.L: [Is it] all the day [that] the plowman plows to sow? \q [Does] he open and harrow his ground?
en.B: Does the farmer who plows to plant go on plowing all day long? \q Does he never stop breaking open and harrowing his soil?
en.R: A farmer does not spend all his time plowing so that he can plant. \q He does not keep on breaking up the dirt and smoothing it forever.

es.L: ¿[Es] todo el día [que] el labrador ara para sembrar? \q ¿[Acaso] abre y rastrilla su tierra?
es.B: ¿Se pasa el labrador todo el día arando para sembrar? \q ¿Nunca deja de abrir y rastrillar su tierra?
es.R: El campesino no se pasa todo el tiempo arando para poder sembrar. \q No sigue rompiendo y alisando la tierra para siempre.

fr.L: [Est-ce] tout le jour [que] le laboureur laboure pour semer ? \q [Est-ce qu’]il ouvre et herse son sol [sans fin] ?
fr.B: Le laboureur qui laboure pour semer laboure-t-il toute la journée ? \q Passe-t-il son temps à ouvrir et à herser sa terre ?
fr.R: Un paysan ne passe pas tout son temps à labourer pour pouvoir semer. \q Il ne continue pas sans fin à retourner la terre et à l’aplanir.

sw.L: Je, [ni] mchana kutwa mkulima analima ili apande? \q [Je,] anaendelea kufungua na kuchakura udongo wake?
sw.B: Je, mkulima anayelima ili kupanda huendelea kulima mchana kutwa? \q Je, haachi kamwe kuvunja na kusawazisha udongo wake?
sw.R: Mkulima hatumii muda wake wote kulima ili apate kupanda. \q Haendelei kuvunja udongo na kuusawazisha milele.

vi.L: [Có phải] suốt ngày người thợ cày cứ cày để gieo? \q [Có phải] người ấy cứ xới và bừa đất mình?
vi.B: Người nông dân cày đất để gieo giống, có phải cứ cày mãi suốt ngày chăng? \q Có phải người ấy không bao giờ thôi xới đất và bừa đất mình chăng?
vi.R: Người nông dân không cày đất mãi để gieo giống. \q Người ấy không xới và bừa đất mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: all the day: endlessly; the question expects the answer no
decisions.reason: "All the day" means continually. Plowing and harrowing have a set time, and then the farmer moves on to sowing.

decisions.choice: statements instead of questions
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the questions expect.

source.text: הֲלוֹא֙ אִם־שִׁוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֥יץ קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֣ן יִזְרֹ֑ק וְשָׂ֨ם חִטָּ֤ה שׂוֹרָה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֣ה נִסְמָ֔ן וְכֻסֶּ֖מֶת גְּבֻלָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Is it not, when he has leveled its surface, and he scatters black cumin, and cumin he sprinkles, and he puts wheat [in] rows and barley [in an] appointed [place] and spelt [at] its border?

en.L: Is it not [so]: when he has leveled its surface, \q he scatters black cumin and sows cumin, \q and puts wheat [in] rows, and barley [in an] appointed [place], and spelt [at] its border?
en.B: Once he has made the ground level, \q does he not scatter black cumin, sow cumin seed, \q set wheat in rows, barley in its marked plot, and spelt along the border?
en.R: No, after he makes the ground smooth, he plants his seeds. \q He scatters spice seeds like black cumin and cumin. \q He plants wheat in rows and barley in its own place. He plants another grain, called spelt, around the edges.

es.L: ¿No es [así]: cuando ha allanado su superficie, \q esparce el comino negro y siembra el comino, \q y pone el trigo [en] hileras, y la cebada [en su lugar] señalado, y la espelta [en] su borde?
es.B: Una vez que ha emparejado la tierra, \q ¿no esparce el comino negro, siembra el comino, \q pone el trigo en hileras, la cebada en su parcela señalada y la espelta en el borde?
es.R: No, después de alisar la tierra, siembra sus semillas. \q Esparce semillas de especias, como el comino negro y el comino. \q Siembra el trigo en hileras y la cebada en su propio lugar. Siembra otro grano, llamado espelta, alrededor de los bordes.

fr.L: N’est-ce pas [ainsi] : quand il en a aplani la surface, \q il répand la nigelle et sème le cumin, \q et il met le blé [en] rangées, et l’orge [à la place] marquée, et l’épeautre [sur] sa bordure ?
fr.B: Une fois le sol aplani, \q ne répand-il pas la nigelle, ne sème-t-il pas le cumin, \q ne met-il pas le blé en rangées, l’orge dans la parcelle marquée et l’épeautre en bordure ?
fr.R: Non, après avoir aplani la terre, il sème ses graines. \q Il répand des graines d’épices comme la nigelle et le cumin. \q Il plante le blé en rangées, et l’orge à sa place. Il plante une autre céréale, l’épeautre, tout autour.

sw.L: Je, si [hivyo]: akisha kuusawazisha uso wake, \q hutawanya jira nyeusi na kupanda jira, \q na kuweka ngano [katika] mistari, na shayiri [mahali] palipowekwa, na kusemethi [pembeni] mwake?
sw.B: Akishausawazisha udongo, \q je, hatawanyi jira nyeusi, akapanda mbegu za jira, \q akaweka ngano kwa mistari, shayiri katika sehemu yake iliyowekwa alama, na kusemethi kando ya mpaka?
sw.R: Hapana, akishausawazisha udongo, anapanda mbegu zake. \q Anatawanya mbegu za viungo kama jira nyeusi na jira. \q Anapanda ngano kwa mistari na shayiri mahali pake. Anapanda nafaka nyingine, iitwayo kusemethi, kandokando.

vi.L: Chẳng phải [vậy] sao: khi đã san phẳng mặt đất, \q người ấy rải hạt thì là đen và gieo hạt thì là, \q và đặt lúa mì [thành] hàng, lúa mạch [vào chỗ] đã định, và lúa mì nâu [ở] bờ ruộng?
vi.B: Khi đã san phẳng mặt đất, \q chẳng phải người ấy rải hạt thì là đen, gieo hạt thì là, \q trồng lúa mì theo hàng, lúa mạch vào khu đã định, và lúa mì nâu dọc theo bờ ruộng sao?
vi.R: Không, sau khi làm cho đất bằng phẳng, người ấy gieo hạt giống. \q Người ấy rải hạt gia vị như thì là đen và thì là. \q Người ấy trồng lúa mì theo hàng và lúa mạch ở chỗ riêng của nó. Người ấy trồng một loại lúa khác gọi là lúa mì nâu quanh bờ ruộng.

decisions.choice: black cumin, cumin, spelt: crops of the land
decisions.reason: Black cumin (nigella) and cumin are small seeds used as spice. Spelt is a hardy wheat. Each crop is sown in its own way and place.

decisions.choice: in rows; in its appointed place
decisions.reason: Both words are rare and their sense is uncertain. The first may mean "in rows" and the second "in a marked place". The point is clear: the farmer puts each seed where it belongs.

decisions.choice: No, after ...
decisions.reason: Readable answers the question of verse 24 and states the answer this question expects.

decisions.choice: el comino negro; el comino
decisions.reason: Qetsah is black cumin (nigella), not dill (meaning decision m1), so it is "comino negro", and kammon is "comino". The "eneldo" of Matthew 23:23 renders a different, Greek plant name (anethon, dill) and is not reused here. "Neguilla" names the same plant but is less widely known.

decisions.choice: "jira nyeusi", "jira", "kusemethi"
decisions.reason: Swahili has no settled words for these crops: "jira" is the common name of cumin, "jira nyeusi" is offered for black cumin (nigella), and "kusemethi" for spelt, the older Swahili word for this grain; a native reviewer should check all three, here and in verse 27.

decisions.choice: "la nigelle" for qetsaḥ (black cumin)
decisions.reason: "Nigelle" is the French name of the plant; Readable adds that it is a spice seed, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "thì là đen", "thì là", "lúa mì nâu"
decisions.reason: Plain names for the crops of the meaning decision: black cumin and cumin are small spice seeds, and spelt is a hardy wheat, so "lúa mì nâu".

source.text: וְיִסְּר֥וֹ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אֱלֹהָ֥יו יוֹרֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he instructs him for the right way; his God he teaches him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} instructs him in the right way; his God teaches him.
en.B: His God has trained him in the proper order of things and teaches him.
en.R: God teaches the farmer how to do these things. God shows him the right way.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo instruye en lo recto; su Dios le enseña.
es.B: Su Dios lo ha instruido en el orden debido y le enseña.
es.R: Dios le enseña al campesino cómo hacer estas cosas. Dios le muestra el camino correcto.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’instruit selon la règle ; son Dieu l’enseigne.
fr.B: Son Dieu lui a appris la bonne manière de faire et l’enseigne.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui apprend au paysan à faire ces choses. Dieu lui montre la bonne manière.

sw.L: Naye humfundisha njia iliyo sawa; Mungu wake humfunza.
sw.B: Mungu wake amemfundisha utaratibu unaofaa na humfunza.
sw.R: Mungu humfundisha mkulima jinsi ya kufanya mambo haya. Mungu humwonyesha njia iliyo sawa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy bảo người ấy theo cách đúng; Đức Chúa Trời của người ấy dạy người ấy.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời của người ấy đã huấn luyện người ấy làm mọi việc theo đúng thứ tự và dạy dỗ người ấy.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời dạy người nông dân cách làm những việc này. Đức Chúa Trời chỉ cho người ấy cách làm đúng.

decisions.choice: his God teaches him: the farmer's skill is God's gift
decisions.reason: The word for the right way also means "judgment" or "justice", the word of verses 6 and 17. The farmer's sense of order comes from God; so does the order of God's own dealings with his people.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בֶֽחָרוּץ֙ י֣וּדַשׁ קֶ֔צַח וְאוֹפַ֣ן עֲגָלָ֔ה עַל־כַּמֹּ֖ן יוּסָּ֑ב כִּ֧י בַמַּטֶּ֛ה יֵחָ֥בֶט קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֥ן בַּשָּֽׁבֶט׃

records.literal_gloss: For not with the sledge is threshed black cumin, and a wheel of a cart over cumin is turned; for with the staff is beaten out black cumin, and cumin with the rod.

en.L: For not with the threshing sledge is black cumin threshed, \q and a wheel of a cart over cumin [is not] turned; \q but with the staff black cumin is beaten out, and cumin with the rod.
en.B: No one threshes black cumin with a sledge or rolls cart wheels over cumin. \q Black cumin is knocked loose with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
en.R: A farmer does not use a heavy sledge to thresh black cumin. He does not roll a cart wheel over cumin seeds. \q He beats the seeds loose with a stick.

es.L: Porque no se trilla el comino negro con el trillo, \q ni se hace girar rueda de carreta sobre el comino; \q sino que con el palo se sacude el comino negro, y el comino con la vara.
es.B: Nadie trilla el comino negro con trillo ni hace rodar ruedas de carreta sobre el comino. \q El comino negro se desgrana con un palo, y el comino con una vara.
es.R: El campesino no usa un trillo pesado para trillar el comino negro. No hace rodar una rueda de carreta sobre las semillas de comino. \q Las sacude con un palo.

fr.L: Car ce n’est pas avec le traîneau qu’on foule la nigelle, \q et la roue du chariot ne tourne pas sur le cumin ; \q mais c’est avec le bâton qu’on bat la nigelle, et le cumin avec la baguette.
fr.B: On ne foule pas la nigelle avec le traîneau, et on ne fait pas passer les roues du chariot sur le cumin. \q On fait tomber la nigelle avec un bâton, et le cumin avec une baguette.
fr.R: Un paysan n’utilise pas un lourd traîneau pour battre la nigelle. Il ne fait pas rouler une roue de chariot sur les graines de cumin. \q Il fait tomber les graines avec un bâton.

sw.L: Kwa maana jira nyeusi haipurwi kwa chombo cha kupuria, \q wala gurudumu la gari halizungushwi juu ya jira; \q bali jira nyeusi hupigwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.
sw.B: Hakuna anayepura jira nyeusi kwa chombo kizito cha kupuria wala kuzungusha magurudumu ya gari juu ya jira. \q Jira nyeusi hupigwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.
sw.R: Mkulima hatumii chombo kizito cha kupuria kupura jira nyeusi. Hazungushi gurudumu la gari juu ya mbegu za jira. \q Anazipiga mbegu kwa fimbo ili zitoke.

vi.L: Vì thì là đen không đập bằng bàn đập lúa, \q và bánh xe bò không lăn trên thì là; \q nhưng thì là đen được đập bằng gậy, và thì là bằng roi.
vi.B: Không ai đập thì là đen bằng bàn đập lúa hay lăn bánh xe bò trên thì là. \q Thì là đen được đập bằng que, và thì là bằng roi.
vi.R: Người nông dân không dùng bàn đập lúa nặng nề để đập thì là đen. Người ấy không lăn bánh xe bò trên hạt thì là. \q Người ấy dùng gậy đập cho hạt rơi ra.

decisions.choice: threshing sledge, cart wheel: heavy tools for threshing grain
decisions.reason: A threshing sledge was a heavy board studded underneath with sharp stones or iron, dragged over grain on the threshing floor (41:15). Cart wheels were also driven over grain. Small seeds like cumin would be crushed by them, so they were beaten out with sticks.

source.text: לֶ֣חֶם יוּדָ֔ק כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח אָד֣וֹשׁ יְדוּשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְ֠הָמַם גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו לֹֽא־יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bread [grain] is crushed, for not forever continually does he thresh it, and he drives [the] wheel of his cart and his horses, not he crushes it.

en.L: Bread [grain] is crushed, but not forever does [one] keep threshing it; \q and [he] drives the wheel of his cart and his horses [over it], [but] he does not crush it [fine].
en.B: Grain for bread must be crushed, but no one keeps on threshing it endlessly. \q He drives the wheels of his cart and his horses over it, but he does not grind it to dust.
en.R: Wheat must be threshed to make bread. But a farmer does not keep on threshing it forever. \q He drives his cart and horses over it, but he does not crush the grain to powder.

es.L: El grano del pan se trilla, pero no para siempre lo sigue trillando; \q y pasa la rueda de su carreta y sus caballos [sobre él], [pero] no lo tritura.
es.B: El grano para el pan se tiene que trillar, pero nadie lo trilla sin fin. \q Pasa sobre él las ruedas de su carreta y sus caballos, pero no lo hace polvo.
es.R: El trigo se tiene que trillar para hacer pan. Pero el campesino no sigue trillándolo para siempre. \q Pasa su carreta y sus caballos sobre él, pero no tritura el grano hasta hacerlo polvo.

fr.L: Le [grain du] pain est broyé, mais on ne le foule pas sans fin, toujours ; \q et [on] pousse [sur lui] la roue de son chariot et ses chevaux, [mais] on ne l’écrase pas.
fr.B: Le grain pour le pain doit être broyé, mais personne ne le foule sans fin. \q On fait passer dessus les roues du chariot et les chevaux, mais on ne le réduit pas en poussière.
fr.R: Il faut battre le blé pour faire du pain. Mais un paysan ne continue pas à le battre sans arrêt. \q Il fait passer son chariot et ses chevaux dessus, mais il n’écrase pas le grain jusqu’à en faire de la poudre.

sw.L: Nafaka [ya mkate] hupondwa, lakini [mtu] haendelei kuipura milele; \q na huendesha gurudumu la gari lake na farasi wake [juu yake], [lakini] haiponde [kabisa].
sw.B: Nafaka ya mkate lazima ipurwe, lakini hakuna anayeendelea kuipura bila kikomo. \q Huendesha magurudumu ya gari lake na farasi wake juu yake, lakini haisagi kuwa vumbi.
sw.R: Ngano lazima ipurwe ili kutengeneza mkate. Lakini mkulima haendelei kuipura milele. \q Huendesha gari lake na farasi juu yake, lakini haiponde nafaka kuwa unga.

vi.L: Lúa làm bánh bị nghiền, nhưng [người ta] không đập nó mãi mãi; \q và [người ấy] lùa bánh xe bò và ngựa của mình [trên nó], [nhưng] người ấy không nghiền nát nó.
vi.B: Lúa làm bánh phải được nghiền, nhưng không ai đập nó mãi không thôi. \q Người ta cho bánh xe bò và ngựa lăn qua nó, nhưng không nghiền nó thành bụi.
vi.R: Lúa mì phải được đập để làm bánh. Nhưng người nông dân không đập nó mãi. \q Người ấy cho xe và ngựa đi qua lúa, nhưng không nghiền hạt thành bột.

decisions.choice: bread grain is crushed: a statement, with the limit that follows
decisions.reason: The first words may be a statement ("grain is crushed") or a question ("is bread grain crushed?"). Either way the point is the next clause: threshing has a limit, and the grain is not destroyed.

decisions.choice: not forever: judgment with a purpose and a limit
decisions.reason: Threshing pictures judgment (21:10; 41:15). As the farmer threshes each crop in its own way and stops before ruining the grain, God's judgment on his people is measured and aims at a harvest, not at destruction.

decisions.choice: his horses: the animals that pull the threshing cart
decisions.reason: The word can mean horses or horsemen; here, the draft animals.

source.text: גַּם־זֹ֕את מֵעִ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יָצָ֑אָה הִפְלִ֣יא עֵצָ֔ה הִגְדִּ֖יל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Also this from with Yahweh of hosts it has gone out; he has made wonderful counsel, he has made great sound wisdom.

en.L: This also has gone out from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made counsel wonderful; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made wisdom great.
en.B: This too comes from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q whose counsel is a wonder and whose wisdom is great.
en.R: The farmer's skill also comes from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q His advice is wonderful. His wisdom is great.

es.L: También esto ha salido {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho maravilloso el consejo; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha engrandecido la sabiduría.
es.B: También esto viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q cuyo consejo es una maravilla y cuya sabiduría es grande.
es.R: La habilidad del campesino también viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Sus consejos son maravillosos. Su sabiduría es grande.

fr.L: Cela aussi est sorti {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu le conseil merveilleux ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu la sagesse grande.
fr.B: Cela aussi vient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, \q dont le conseil est merveilleux et la sagesse grande.
fr.R: L’habileté du paysan vient aussi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées. \q Ses conseils sont merveilleux. Sa sagesse est grande.

sw.L: Hili nalo limetoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi; \q amefanya shauri kuwa la ajabu; amefanya hekima kuwa kuu.
sw.B: Hili nalo linatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q ambaye shauri {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni la ajabu na hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni kuu.
sw.R: Ujuzi wa mkulima nao unatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Shauri {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni la ajabu. Hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni kuu.

vi.L: Điều này cũng đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho mưu định kỳ diệu; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho sự khôn ngoan lớn lao.
vi.B: Điều này cũng đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, \q Đấng có mưu định kỳ diệu và sự khôn ngoan lớn lao.
vi.R: Sự khéo léo của người nông dân cũng đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. \q Lời khuyên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật kỳ diệu. Sự khôn ngoan của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.

decisions.choice: wonderful counsel: the LORD's plan, beyond human understanding
decisions.reason: The same two roots form the royal title "Wonderful Counselor" in 9:5. God's plan is marvelous (25:1), both in the farmer's craft and in his dealings with his people.

decisions.choice: wisdom: sound, effective wisdom that succeeds
decisions.reason: The word means practical wisdom that achieves its aim (Proverbs 2:7; 8:14).

decisions.choice: The farmer's skill
decisions.reason: Readable says what "this" refers to: the farmer's knowledge of verses 24-28.
